title: My Parents GLOW In The Dark 💡
premise: In my town you glow while you keep a secret, brighter every day. My parents have glowed like lighthouses for thirty years, and one Friday at our pizza booth I finally ask each of them what they are hiding.
twist: The huge secret is tiny and the same on both sides: neither of them liked the pizza on their first date, and each has ordered it every Friday since so the other won't feel bad. I promise to keep it, so now I glow too.
world: A bright red-and-cream pizza place on a Friday evening: a red vinyl booth by a big window, a checker floor, round pendant lamps, a gumball machine by the door, and a dusky parking lot outside.
